info.rate_factors_body:
**📉 Inflation (devaluation) factors:**
• Admins handing out items with `/itemmod give`
• Daily/hourly rewards minting currency
• Selling items to the shop (new currency enters circulation)

**📈 Deflation (appreciation) factors:**
• Buying items from the shop (currency is burned)
• Player-to-player trades (fees burn currency)
• Currency exchange (fees burn currency)
